MutationContext.description: Metadata every mutation must carry so retries and stale edits are safe.

TaskMode.description: The closed Task mode vocabulary on the wire (KAN-S4-US4): whether a human or an agent executes the bounded work.

oneOf.description: An agent executes the work under dispatch.

TaskSubtype.description: The closed Task subtype vocabulary on the wire (DR-TK-06): the seven bounded flavours of non-story work.

oneOf.description: Keeping the product and its operations running.
Finding out what is true before acting on it.
Learning without a deliverable committed up front.
Proving an approach before committing to it.
Moving work or data from one place to another.
Work done by hand, on purpose.

TicketCriterion.description: One story-linked criterion a Ticket claims: an observable outcome and the User Stories it delivers, named like `CORE-S3-US6` or `S3-US6` (DR-TK-04, DR-PS-13).

outcome.description: The observable outcome the criterion states.

stories.description: The User Stories the criterion claims.

TicketKind.description: The closed Ticket kind vocabulary on the wire (DR-TK-01).

oneOf.description: A small vertical product slice of exactly one Spec.
A record of incorrect behaviour, with qualification evidence.
Bounded operational, investigative, or administrative work.

TicketPriority.description: The closed priority vocabulary on the wire (DR-LC-12): urgent, high, normal, low.

description: Request payload for the `ticket.create` command. Each kind sends exactly its own fields: an Implementation names its Spec, slice, and criteria; a Bug names its quick-capture facts; a Task names its title, subtype, mode, completion criteria, and optional timing. Fields the kind does not carry are simply absent.

actual_behaviour.description: The Bug's actual behaviour (DR-TK-08); required for a Bug.

completion.description: The Task's completion criteria: observable outcomes that bound the work, with no story links.

criteria.description: The Implementation's story-linked criteria. A Task never carries these (DR-TK-07); it sends `completion` instead.

kind.description: The kind whose schema the Ticket carries.

project_id.description: The Project the new Ticket belongs to.

reporter_evidence.description: The Bug's reporter evidence (DR-TK-08); required for a Bug.

scheduled_for.description: The Task's one-time activation instant, RFC 3339; stored for KAN-S11, whose activation behaviour is KAN-T53 and KAN-T54.

slice.description: The Implementation slice description, naming the behaviour delivered end to end.

spec_id.description: The Spec this Ticket attaches to. An Implementation must name exactly one (DR-TK-02); a Bug or Task may name one or none (DR-TK-03).

subtype.description: The Task's subtype; a Task names exactly one (DR-TK-06).
